summary: The paving crew can finish {street} on Friday but the striping supervisor has another crew call that afternoon.
realLife: Oakland proposed adding paint crews to cover more in-house resurfacing while keeping other traffic-marking work moving.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: paving completion, striping availability and competing marking order.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: paving completion, striping availability and competing marking order.
turns.what: Give the newly available paint crew the resurfaced street.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: paving completion, striping availability and competing marking order.
turns.what: Reschedule the paving finish to a date with confirmed striping coverage.
